name: plain-language
description: Makes Claude Code write in plain language, following ISO 24495-1:2023, ISO 24495-3:2026, and the GOV.UK content guidance. Hooks add the rules to every session and check each chat reply and each prose file.

findings.title: Findings on screen
findings.description: What the screen shows when Claude must write a reply again. With file, you see one short message, and Claude reads the findings from a file. With short, you see each finding with its advice. With full, you also see an example and the path to the rules.

hide_drafts.title: Hide replies that break the rules
hide_drafts.description: Hide a reply that Claude must write again. Each reply then appears only when it is complete. Turn this off to see each reply line by line, as Claude writes it.
